ContactFormSubmission.title: ContactFormSubmission
ContactFormSubmission.description: Represents a contact form submission from the website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the contact form submission.

name.description: Name of the person submitting the form.

email.description: Email address of the person submitting the form.

subject.description: Subject of the contact form submission.

message.description: The message content of the contact form submission.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp of when the form was submitted.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile information.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Authentication.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

definition.description: Stores contact form submissions from the website. No denormalized authorization fields are needed since all submissions are publicly accessible for admin review.

params.name: contactFormSubmissionId
params.description: Unique identifier for the contact form submission.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's unique ID, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore structure prioritizes security and scalability. Contact form submissions are in a separate collection with write-only public access. User profiles are stored in a `users` collection, where each user can only read and write to their own document, ensuring data privacy.
